note: The silhouette fit behind ffd.json (tools/ffdfit.py over the r34 scripts) and the settings the checks use. cams_ffd.json = the cameras and car poses (dy, pitch) solved with the lattice, used by loop.py / compare.py / lampfit.py / lampback.py (--cams fit/cams_ffd.json --ffd ffd.json). Roll set by hand after the fit (the silhouettes leave it free; the symmetric lamp pairs fix it): r29 +0.030 rad, r37 +0.002 rad. Photos are fetched to a scratch dir (tools/fetch.py, ref/), never copied into textures; masks/ are the hand masks of other cars and people in front of the car. A lattice refit with the lamp anchors added (lampanchors.py) made the silhouettes worse and was not adopted.
